mapper.sql: SELECT bok.icam06_fund_cd AS fund_code , bok.icam06_fund_nm AS fund_name , bok.icam06_cur AS cur , CASE WHEN bok.icam06_cur = 'KRW' THEN bok.icam06_principal ELSE bok.icam06_for_principal END AS for_principal , CASE WHEN bok.icam06_cur = 'KRW' THEN bok.icam06_principal - COALESCE(preBok.icam06_principal ,0) ELSE bok.icam06_for_principal - COALESCE(preBok.icam06_for_principal,0) END AS principal_diff , CASE WHEN bok.icam06_cur = 'KRW' THEN bok.icam06_nav ELSE bok.icam06_for_nav END AS for_nav , CASE WHEN bok.icam06_cur = 'KRW' THEN bok.icam06_nav - COALESCE(preBok.icam06_nav ,0) ELSE bok.icam06_for_nav - COALESCE(preBok.icam06_for_nav ,0) END AS nav_diff , CASE WHEN bok.icam06_cur = 'KRW' THEN bok.icam06_std_price ELSE bok.icam06_for_std_price END AS for_std_price , CASE WHEN bok.icam06_cur = 'KRW' THEN bok.icam06_std_price - COALESCE(preBok.icam06_std_price ,0) ELSE bok.icam06_for_std_price - COALESCE(preBok.icam06_for_std_price,0) END AS std_price_diff , CASE WHEN bok.icam06_cur = 'KRW' THEN bok.icam06_tax_price ELSE bok.icam06_for_tax_price END AS for_tax_price , CASE WHEN bok.icam06_cur = 'KRW' THEN bok.icam06_tax_price - COALESCE(preBok.icam06_tax_price ,0) ELSE bok.icam06_for_tax_price - COALESCE(preBok.icam06_for_tax_price,0) END AS tax_price_diff FROM icam06_fund_book bok LEFT JOIN icam06_fund_book preBok ON ( preBok.icam06_icam_company_cd = bok.icam06_icam_company_cd AND preBok.icam06_fund_cd = bok.icam06_fund_cd AND preBok.icam06_std_date = bok.icam06_std_date - 1 ) WHERE bok.icam06_icam_company_cd = ( SELECT sys01_icam_company_cd FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId} ) AND bok.icam06_std_date = #{stdDate}::date AND bok.icam06_fund_cd != COALESCE(bok.icam06_multi_class_cd,'') UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ( WITH book AS ( SELECT prc.* , prc.ifi32_principal - COALESCE(prePrc.ifi32_principal,0) AS principal_diff , prc.ifi32_nav - COALESCE(prePrc.ifi32_nav ,0) AS nav_diff , prc.ifi32_price - COALESCE(prePrc.ifi32_price ,0) AS std_price_diff , prc.ifi32_tax_price - COALESCE(prePrc.ifi32_tax_price,0) AS tax_price_diff FROM ifi32_fund_price prc LEFT JOIN ifi32_fund_price prePrc ON ( prePrc.ifi32_if_cd = prc.ifi32_if_cd AND prePrc.ifi32_am_corp_cd = prc.ifi32_am_corp_cd AND prePrc.ifi32_std_date = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(prc.ifi32_std_date,'yyyymmdd')-1,'yyyymmdd') AND prePrc.ifi32_fund_cd = prc.ifi32_fund_cd AND prePrc.ifi32_cur_cd = prc.ifi32_cur_cd ) WHERE (prc.ifi32_if_cd, prc.ifi32_am_corp_cd) IN ( SELECT ifi29_if_cd, ifi29_am_corp_cd FROM ifi29_am_corp_mapping WHERE ifi29_company_id = #{companyId} AND #{stdDate}::date BETWEEN ifi29_start_date AND COALESCE(ifi29_end_date, '2999-12-31'::date) ) AND prc.ifi32_std_date = TO_CHAR(#{stdDate}::date,'yyyymmdd') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ifi32_fund_price a WHERE a.ifi32_if_cd = prc.ifi32_if_cd AND a.ifi32_am_corp_cd = prc.ifi32_am_corp_cd AND a.ifi32_std_date = prc.ifi32_std_date AND a.ifi32_multi_class_func_cd = prc.ifi32_fund_cd ) ) SELECT bok.ifi32_fund_cd AS fund_code , bok.ifi32_fund_nm AS fund_name , COALESCE(forBok.ifi32_cur_cd, bok.ifi32_cur_cd) AS cur , CASE WHEN forBok.ifi32_cur_cd IS NULL THEN bok.ifi32_principal ELSE forBok.ifi32_principal END AS for_principal , CASE WHEN forBok.ifi32_cur_cd IS NULL THEN bok.principal_diff ELSE forBok.principal_diff END AS principal_diff , CASE WHEN forBok.ifi32_cur_cd IS NULL THEN bok.ifi32_nav ELSE forBok.ifi32_nav END AS for_nav , CASE WHEN forBok.ifi32_cur_cd IS NULL THEN bok.nav_diff ELSE forBok.nav_diff END AS nav_diff , CASE WHEN forBok.ifi32_cur_cd IS NULL THEN bok.ifi32_price ELSE forBok.ifi32_price END AS for_std_price , CASE WHEN forBok.ifi32_cur_cd IS NULL THEN bok.std_price_diff ELSE forBok.std_price_diff END AS std_price_diff , CASE WHEN forBok.ifi32_cur_cd IS NULL THEN bok.ifi32_tax_price ELSE forBok.ifi32_tax_price END AS for_tax_price , CASE WHEN forBok.ifi32_cur_cd IS NULL THEN bok.tax_price_diff ELSE forBok.tax_price_diff END AS tax_price_diff FROM book bok LEFT JOIN book forBok ON ( forBok.ifi32_if_cd = bok.ifi32_if_cd AND forBok.ifi32_am_corp_cd = bok.ifi32_am_corp_cd AND forBok.ifi32_std_date = bok.ifi32_std_date AND forBok.ifi32_fund_cd = bok.ifi32_fund_cd AND forBok.ifi32_cur_cd != 'KRW' ) WHERE bok.ifi32_cur_cd = 'KRW' ) t
